subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Dimensions and exchange in model cells
stimulus.description: Three cube-shaped model cells were made from the same material. The table shows side length and the percentage of the model volume reached by a diffusing substance after the same time.
stimulus.note: All models were exposed to the same concentration of the diffusing substance for 10 minutes.

question: Analyse the relationship between cell size, surface area to volume ratio and the percentage reached by diffusion. Explain why this relationship can limit cell size.
markscheme: As side length increases, surface area to volume ratio decreases.
The percentage of the volume reached by diffusion decreases as side length increases.
The 2 mm model has the highest surface area to volume ratio and the greatest percentage reached by diffusion.
A lower surface area to volume ratio provides less exchange surface relative to the amount of cell material requiring resources or waste removal.
As diffusion distance increases in a larger cell, diffusion becomes less effective for supplying the whole cell rapidly.
markschemeJa: 一辺の長さが大きくなるほど表面積対体積比は低下する。
一辺の長さが大きくなるほど、同じ時間内に拡散物質が到達する体積割合も低下する。
2 mmのモデルは表面積対体積比が最も高く、拡散が到達した割合も最も高い。
表面積対体積比が低いと、物質交換を必要とする細胞内容量に対して利用できる交換面積が少なくなる。
大きい細胞では拡散距離も長くなるため、細胞全体へ物質を迅速に供給する効率が低下する。
modelAnswer: As the model cell becomes larger, its surface area to volume ratio falls from 3.0:1 to 0.75:1, and the proportion reached by diffusion falls from 92% to 34%. Larger cells therefore have less exchange surface per unit volume and longer internal diffusion distances. These effects make diffusion less effective at supplying materials and removing wastes throughout the cell, which helps explain why cell size is limited.
modelAnswerJa: モデル細胞が大きくなると表面積対体積比は3.0:1から0.75:1へ低下し、拡散が到達した割合も92%から34%へ低下しています。大きい細胞ほど体積に対する交換面積が少なく、内部の拡散距離も長くなります。そのため、必要物質の供給や老廃物の除去を拡散だけで効率よく行うことが難しくなり、細胞サイズの制約につながります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Stomatal density and water loss
stimulus.description: Leaves from plants grown under two light conditions were examined. Mean stomatal density and water loss from detached leaves were measured.
stimulus.note: Each mean was calculated from leaves from ten plants. Temperature and air movement were kept constant during water-loss measurements.

question: Using the data, evaluate the conclusion that higher stomatal density causes greater water loss. Include one limitation of the evidence.
markscheme: Plants grown in high light had both higher stomatal density and higher mean water loss.
The association is consistent with more stomata providing more pathways for water vapour to leave the leaf when stomata are open.
The data show correlation between growth condition, stomatal density and water loss but do not by themselves prove causation.
Other differences caused by the growth conditions, such as leaf thickness, stomatal opening or leaf area, could also affect water loss.
A stronger test would manipulate stomatal density or compare otherwise similar leaves while controlling additional variables and measuring replication or variation.
markschemeJa: 高光量で育てた植物は気孔密度が高く、平均の水分損失量も大きい。
気孔が多ければ、気孔が開いているときに水蒸気が葉から出る経路が増えるため、この関係は生物学的に説明できる。
ただし、このデータは生育条件・気孔密度・水分損失の相関を示すだけで、気孔密度が原因だと直接証明してはいない。
光条件によって葉の厚さ、気孔の開き具合、葉面積など別の要因も変化し、水分損失に影響した可能性がある。
より強い検証には、他の条件をより厳密に統制し、気孔密度を独立に変えるか、ばらつきや反復を十分に測定する必要がある。
modelAnswer: The high-light plants had 148 stomata mm⁻² and lost 0.71 g h⁻¹, compared with 86 stomata mm⁻² and 0.42 g h⁻¹ in low light. This supports an association because additional stomata could provide more routes for water vapour loss. However, the experiment does not isolate stomatal density as the only changed factor. High-light growth may also alter leaf area, thickness or stomatal opening. The data therefore support the hypothesis but do not prove that stomatal density alone caused the greater water loss.
modelAnswerJa: 高光量で育てた植物は気孔密度が148個/mm²で水分損失が0.71 g h⁻¹、低光量では86個/mm²で0.42 g h⁻¹でした。気孔が多いほど水蒸気が出る経路が増えるため、この結果は仮説と一致します。しかし、光条件は気孔密度以外にも葉面積や葉の厚さ、気孔の開閉などを変える可能性があります。したがって、このデータは関連を支持しますが、気孔密度だけが原因だとは証明できません。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Light intensity and photosynthetic rate
stimulus.description: A water plant was exposed to increasing light intensity while temperature and carbon dioxide concentration were kept constant.
stimulus.note: Each point is the mean of five measurements.

question: Analyse the effect of light intensity on photosynthetic rate and explain why the curve approaches a plateau.
markscheme: Photosynthetic rate increases strongly from 0 to about 60–80 light units.
The increase becomes smaller at high light intensity and the rate is nearly constant between 80 and 100 units.
At low light intensity, light availability limits the light-dependent reactions.
At high light intensity, light is no longer the main limiting factor.
Another factor such as carbon dioxide availability, temperature or biochemical capacity limits the maximum rate under these conditions.
markschemeJa: 光強度0からおよそ60〜80までは光合成速度が大きく上昇している。
高光量では増加幅が小さくなり、80から100では速度がほぼ一定である。
低光量では光エネルギーの不足が光依存反応を制限する。
高光量では光が主な制限要因ではなくなる。
その後は二酸化炭素濃度、温度、反応系の能力など別の要因が最大速度を制限している。
modelAnswer: Photosynthetic rate rises as light intensity increases, reaching about 9 units by a light intensity of 80. Between 80 and 100 units there is almost no further increase. At low light intensity, light energy limits the light-dependent reactions, so additional light raises the rate. At high light intensity another factor becomes limiting, such as carbon dioxide availability or the capacity of enzyme-controlled reactions, producing the plateau.
modelAnswerJa: 光強度が上がるにつれて光合成速度は増え、80付近で約9まで達します。80から100ではほとんど増加しません。低光量では光エネルギーが制限要因なので光を増やすと速度が上がりますが、高光量では別の要因が制限要因となるため、グラフは頭打ちになります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: UV exposure and mutation frequency
stimulus.description: Cultured cells were exposed to different durations of ultraviolet radiation. Mutation frequency was measured after cell division.
stimulus.note: The same cell line, culture conditions and measurement method were used for every treatment.

question: Deduce the relationship between UV exposure and mutation frequency. Suggest one biological explanation and one improvement that would strengthen the investigation.
markscheme: Mutation frequency increases as UV exposure duration increases.
The increase is substantial across the range, from 4 per 10⁶ cells with no exposure to 58 per 10⁶ cells after 80 s.
UV radiation can damage DNA or alter bases, increasing the chance that replication produces a sequence change if damage is not correctly repaired.
The experiment should include repeated independent cultures at each exposure and report variation or uncertainty.
An additional improvement could use more intermediate exposure levels, control delivered UV dose precisely or verify comparable cell survival between treatments.
markschemeJa: UV照射時間が長くなるほど突然変異頻度は増加している。
0秒では100万細胞あたり4だったのに対し、80秒では58まで増えており、範囲全体で大きな増加が見られる。
UVはDNAを損傷したり塩基を変化させたりし、損傷が正しく修復されなければ複製時に塩基配列の変化が生じる可能性を高める。
各照射時間で独立した培養を複数回行い、ばらつきや不確かさを示すと信頼性が高まる。
さらに照射量をより細かく設定する、実際のUV線量を厳密に管理する、処理間で細胞生存率を確認するなども改善になる。
modelAnswer: Mutation frequency increases with UV exposure, rising from 4 mutations per 10⁶ cells in the control to 58 per 10⁶ cells after 80 seconds. UV can damage DNA, so unrepaired damage may be converted into sequence changes during replication. The investigation would be stronger if each exposure were repeated with independent cultures and the variation were reported. More exposure levels or precise measurement of delivered UV dose would also improve the evidence.
modelAnswerJa: UV照射時間が増えるにつれて突然変異頻度は増加し、対照区の100万細胞あたり4から80秒照射では58まで上昇しています。UVはDNAを損傷するため、修復されなかった損傷が複製時に配列変化として固定される可能性があります。各条件を独立に複数回反復し、ばらつきを示せば、より信頼性の高い結果になります。
